name: Coordinated Counterattack
summary: It is played as a block and puts the whole line back on its feet.

face.name: Coordinated Counterattack

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Play this card as a block. If you control at least 3 Human Entities, untap the Human Entities you control: they gain Counterattack +1 until end of turn.

face.flavor: No one shouts the order. They turn together.
